meta.title: Nutrient content of common Indian fertilizers and government-controlled prices
meta.note: Nutrient % are FCO minimum guaranteed / nominal grade values. P as P2O5, K as K2O. NBS per-kg subsidy rates for Rabi 2026-27 were reported in news (N 94.21, P 66.11, K 2.38, S 10.42 Rs/kg) but the PIB factsheet could not be fetched (HTTP 403) - not included as verified data.

prices.basis: statutorily fixed MRP; exclusive of neem-coating charges and taxes as applicable (~Rs 538/quintal)
prices.as_of: 2026-03 (reported Lok Sabha written reply, MoS Anupriya Patel)
prices.source_name: Indian Cooperative news report of Lok Sabha written reply, 22 Mar 2026
prices.corroboration: Earlier Lok Sabha replies (eparlib.sansad.in AU4185, AU790) quote the same Rs 242/45 kg - not reachable from research machine

prices.basis: MRP under NBS (decontrolled; companies fix MRP under government monitoring). Retail price kept unchanged for Rabi 2026-27 (1 Oct 2026 - 31 Mar 2027)
prices.source_name: AgroSpectrum India, 12 Nov 2026, reporting Cabinet decision announced by Union I&B Minister
prices.source_type: secondary report; official PMIndia release confirms NBS Rabi 2026-27 approval (Rs 62,370.02 crore) but does not state the DAP price

prices.product: MOP, SSP, TSP, NPK/NPKS complexes, ammonium sulphate
prices.basis: Not statutorily fixed: 28 P&K grades are under the Nutrient Based Subsidy scheme (since 1 Apr 2010); companies set MRP, which must be printed on the bag with subsidy per bag/kg (PIB backgrounder, 5 Jan 2026).
